description: This file contains platform-specific shell functions for firmware image checking, copying configuration, and upgrading, based on the board name. It appears to be part of a Linux-based firmware upgrade system, with functions tailored for certain hardware (e.g., watchguard, firebox-m300).

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image for specific board types before upgrade.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data based on board type.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade for specific board types or defaults.
